definition_en: to decorate someone or something, especially richly or showily
core_image: 节日街道挂满彩灯与花环
scene: 新年将至，街道挂满灯笼与花环。The old town was bedecked with lanterns for the festival.
sceneCN: 这里 bedecked 是「被装点」（第 1 个义项：以饰物装扮、布置）；句意是古镇为节庆挂满灯笼。

derivatives.zh: 基础词，义为「装饰；打扮」（deck out）
由过去分词转形容词，义为「装饰过的；挂满饰物的」
由现在分词转名词，义为「装饰；装点」

senses.title: To decorate richly
senses.definition: to adorn someone or something with ornaments
senses.example: The old town was bedecked with lanterns for the festival.
senses.why: The be- prefix makes the decoration cover the object completely.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 be- 表示装饰把对象整个覆盖。

senses.title: To adorn oneself showily
senses.definition: to dress oneself up, often in a showy way
senses.definitionCN: 为自己盛装打扮，常带炫耀意味
senses.example: She bedecked herself in jewels before the ball.
senses.exampleCN: 舞会前她满身珠宝盛装打扮。
senses.why: The covering idea turns inward, as the person becomes the ornamented object.
senses.whyCN: 「覆盖」意象转向自身，人成为被装饰的对象。

intro.en: Bedeck adds be- to deck, itself from Dutch covering cloth.
intro.cn: bedeck 在 deck 前加 be-；deck 源于荷兰语中覆盖的布。

items.en: decken meant to cover or spread.
items.cn: 中古荷兰语 decken 意为「覆盖、铺开」。

items.en: deck meant to clothe or adorn.
items.cn: 中古英语 deck 意为「给……穿衣、打扮」。

items.en: bedeck appeared as an intensified form.
items.cn: 十六世纪 bedeck 作为强化形式出现。

items.en: deck out kept the sense of dressing up.
items.cn: deck out 保留「盛装打扮」之义。

items.en: bedecked with is now the most common pattern.
items.cn: 如今 bedecked with 是最常见搭配。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the be- prefix or the deck root; the near-meaning group gathers words for adorning.
note.cn: 形近组共享 be- 前缀或 deck 词根；近义组汇集装饰类词。

entries.definitionCN: 装饰；打扮——bedeck 的基础词
乱涂；同前缀而意义相反方向
信标；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: to crown with a wreath of flowers
entries.definitionCN: 戴花环；一种具体装饰方式

normalIntro.en: Bedeck is deck with be-: deck it out fully.
normalIntro.cn: bedeck 是 deck 加 be-：把装饰做足。

normal.en: Deck alone can mean to decorate.
Deck out means to dress up richly.
Bedecked with flowers is the classic phrase.
normal.cn: bedecked with flowers 是经典搭配。

normal.en: One can bedeck oneself in jewels.
normal.cn: 可以说 bedeck oneself in jewels。

normal.en: The deck of a ship is a different sense, a covering.
normal.cn: 船的甲板是 deck 的另一义，指「覆盖面」。

abstract.en: See lanterns strung across an old street.
Feel silk and cold jewels at your throat.
abstract.cn: 感受丝缎与颈间冰凉的珠宝。

abstract.en: Picture a plain room turned brilliant.
abstract.cn: 想象朴素的房间焕然生辉。

examples.en: The old town was bedecked with lanterns for the festival.
She bedecked herself in jewels before the ball.
examples.cn: 舞会前她满身珠宝盛装打扮。

examples.en: Streets bedecked with flags welcomed the returning team.
examples.cn: 挂满旗帜的街道迎接归来的队伍。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「比·戴克」——比赛谁戴得克丽夺目，就是「盛装装饰」。

root: 前缀 be-（古英语，表「使、覆盖」）加 deck；deck 源自中古荷兰语 decken「覆盖」，经中古英语先指「穿衣」，再转指「打扮、装饰」，十六世纪与 be- 结合成为 bedeck。

sensesIntro.en: One verb drapes decoration over streets and over oneself.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个动词，把装饰披上街道，也披上自己。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: lanterns and garlands covering an old street.
core.cn: 核心意象：灯笼花环覆满老街。

intro.en: Bedeck joins the be- covering family, the bright twin of bedaub.
intro.cn: bedeck 属于 be- 覆盖家族，是 bedaub 光鲜的孪生词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the root is Middle Dutch decken.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，词根是中古荷兰语 decken。

derivatives.zh: 基础词，义为「装饰；打扮」（deck out）
由过去分词转形容词，义为「装饰过的；挂满饰物的」
